nodes.statement: Fix one bearer, present interval, complete application signature, current causal state, intervention-indexed transition/readout kernels, exogenous coupling and future trace space.
nodes.scope: Controlled deterministic or stochastic continuation comparisons; not an actual-token admission.
nodes.quantifier: For every application electing to use the R199 continuation comparison.

nodes.statement: Two occurrences are complete operational clones only when current state, transition/readout kernels and exogenous/noise coupling agree under every declared intervention.
nodes.scope: The declared continuation experiment and horizon.
nodes.quantifier: For every compared pair in the declared controlled domain.

nodes.statement: Complete operational clones have equal future trace distributions and equal distributions for every trace-measurable diagnostic.
nodes.scope: The declared controlled process model; real completeness remains open.
nodes.quantifier: For every admissible future intervention sequence and trace diagnostic.

nodes.statement: No continuation diagnostic identifies an external lineage or training label absent from the complete current causal law.
nodes.scope: Lineage variables external to the declared complete operational clone package.
nodes.quantifier: For every future trace and trace-measurable diagnostic in the declared domain.

nodes.statement: A reliable continuation contrast refutes the declared clone package and may support a current retained difference only under explicit alternative exclusions; it does not by itself identify numerical lineage, RetBind or H.
nodes.quantifier: For every observed diagnostic contrast used in a retention claim.

nodes.statement: Actual current consumer use is an ontic relation while telemetry, behavior and perturbation outcomes are fallible evidence; experimental test conditions are not experiential structure.
nodes.scope: Every physical application of retained route use.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed carrier, consumer, use interval and diagnostic.

nodes.statement: A currently retained-and-used coordinate is not thereby named phenomenal familiarity H; independently fixed signed evidence, same-instance grounding and failure conditions remain required.
nodes.scope: The selected retentive-familiarity target only; not basal experience.
nodes.quantifier: For every proposed bridge from retention/use to H.

nodes.statement: Cross formation condition with instrumented online route use, measure continuation traces separately from O, G and signed H evidence, and treat a complete-state copy as a falsifier of lineage overreach.
nodes.scope: Future bodily/action retentive-familiarity studies; not a consciousness detector.
nodes.quantifier: For every future application of the proposed habitual-versus-novel perturbation design.

rules.statement: Induct over the common state/readout kernel for every fixed intervention sequence.
rules.binding: One fixed bearer-relative comparison, horizon, state/kernel package, intervention word and exogenous coupling are used throughout.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: A difference is possible only if at least one clone premise fails.

rules.statement: Factor every trace diagnostic through the equal continuation law; an omitted external lineage label remains unidentified.
rules.binding: The same external lineage contrast and the same operational-clone pair are used throughout.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If lineage is physically constitutive, include and evidence it in the complete signature; the pair then is not a clone.

rules.statement: Infer only failure of the declared clone package from a diagnostic contrast, adding current-retention attribution only with explicit alternative exclusions.
rules.binding: One preregistered intervention contrast, bearer, interval, diagnostic and alternative set are retained.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: Without exclusions, preserve an identified set of current differences rather than naming one retention mechanism.

rules.statement: Keep actual same-episode consumer use separate from the evidence used to diagnose it.
rules.binding: Bearer, prior occurrence, current carrier, current consumer, episode and evidence provenance must match one application.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If actual use is not independently supported, retain only an evidential hypothesis.

rules.statement: Design a formation-by-use experiment whose traces, route telemetry and signed H evidence are distinct and whose inferences obey the probe ceiling.
rules.binding: One target H, bearer, interval, complete application signature, actual route and predeclared evidence contract are required per application.
rules.alternative_route_semantics: If signed H evidence or actual-use grounding is absent, preserve the bridge as open and report only organizational findings.

context_links.statement: R199 neither proves nor replaces C1; complete-twin experiential invariance is conditional on it.
Retention, familiarity and successful diagnosis are not conditions for basal experience.
Continuation evidence does not replace actual prior occurrence, continuation and current consumer use.
The organizational coordinate still requires a separate familiar-mineness interpretation.
Any UCT transport must preserve bearer, time, signature, parameters and coordinate type; a diagnostic is not transported as constitution.
